audience: insurance agencies that manage customers and policies in Xanatek Connect

useCases.title: Look up a customer and its policies
useCases.text: Search customers by name or status. Open one customer and list every policy it holds.

useCases.title: Check policy renewal dates
useCases.text: List policies by customer, status or policy number. List the renewal terms of one policy with its dates and premium.

useCases.title: Review tasks that are due
useCases.text: List tasks by status or due date, with the managing user. List the staff users of the agency.

useCases.title: Read notes and carriers
useCases.text: List the notes attached to customers, policies and contacts. List the insurance carriers.

useCases.title: Create a task for a staff member
useCases.text: Create a task assigned to a user and linked to a customer or policy. Each call creates a new task.

useCases.title: Complete a task or add a note
useCases.text: Mark one task as completed, or attach a new note to a customer, policy or other entity.
